answer: Every new identity pays a one-time 5 POA sybil tax, burned at registration. One honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward; an attacker minting 100 hollow identities burns 500 POA up front and waits 10 epochs each. A lotus opens only after slow growth, as does profit: each fake's gain cools like an ember, since one epoch pays 40 POA against 500 POA burned plus the wait. Forging at scale is a sure loss; one honest identity stays cheap.
